1.title: Orientation Day & iCEV Program Registration Setup
1.bellRinger: Icebreaker Activity. Students introduce themselves and share one career field in public safety they are curious about.

5.exitTicket: Write a 280-character 'tweet' describing one specific career in private security and its importance.

6.exitTicket: Prepare a 60-second summary speech of the day's pathway. Students pair up and deliver speeches to a peer.

7.bellRinger: Write down your personal, unprompted definition of the word 'justice'.
7.exitTicket: Revisit and revise. Students rewrite their definition of 'justice' incorporating legal concepts learned.
